description: This PHP class implements a specific type of regression, PowerBestFit, which extends a base class BestFit. It provides methods to compute power regression, get values of Y for a given X, get X for a Y, and generate the equation of the best-fit curve. The class is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library under the Shared	rend namespace.

classes.name: PowerBestFit
classes.description: A class for performing power regression (power best-fit) on datasets within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: getValueOfYForX
methods.description: Calculates the Y value for a specific X using the power regression equation.

methods.name: getValueOfXForY
methods.description: Calculates the X value corresponding to a specific Y using the power regression equation.

methods.name: getEquation
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the power regression equation.

methods.name: getIntersect
methods.description: Calculates the intercept value where the curve intersects with Y=0.

methods.name: powerRegression
methods.description: Performs the regression analysis to fit a power model to the data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the regression with provided Y and X values, and executes the regression process if there are no errors.
